reads.body:
Decision: Tom approved loom design rev 2 for LastDB primary memory footprint management via hot/cold eviction and shedding. The design keeps phys_footprint under 12 GiB and returns no 503 for memory pressure.

Unblocks: loom execution lx-20260903T163258.920-80226-1 (memory guard + LRU eviction on primary). Drives the durability canary toward cutover.

Rationale: Measured on 0.23.3-1435 over 20 minutes. Design includes self-metrics, LRU eviction above a 10 GiB soft line, shedding via /api/admin/shed, and the guard script in EdgeVector/last-stack. Feature proof harness: scripts/feature-proof/lastdb-footprint-under-guard/run.sh. Hard constraints honored: no scan, no Mini restart, no hash_field rewrite, no allocator change.
reads.title: Approve loom design rev 2 — LastDB primary memory footprint guard + eviction
